meta.name: Require a tag on resources
meta.description: Every resource that supports tags carries the tag named by tagName. Azure evaluates tags['<tagName>'] exists; Tirith tests the key of the tags map.

evaluators.description: tags map contains the key tagName. error_tolerance 2 is Indexed mode: a type with no tags attribute is out of scope. A resource that supports tags but sets none has tags: null in the plan, which Contains fails, so the untagged resource is refused as Azure would refuse it
